speaker: Leonard
text: Bite me. Sheldon, how could you just sit there and let them spy on me?

speaker: Howard
text: Oh, hey, Leonard. How was your date? You should thank us. When future generations try to determine why your relationship with Penny crashed and burned, this right here is the black box.

speaker: Leonard
text: What are you talking about? The date went fine.

speaker: Raj
text: It's coming. Screen saver. Dude, she said she wants to slow things down.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, so she said she wants to slow things down. It's like saying, I'm really enjoying this meal, I'm going to slow down and savor it.

speaker: Howard
text: No, it's like, this fish tastes bad, so... I'm gonna slow down and spit it out.

speaker: Raj
text: You being the fish.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not the fish.

speaker: Howard
text: Oh, really? Did you make a second date?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, we sort of decided to wing it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: They were clever, Leonard. They exploited my complete lack of interest in what you were doing. Oh, even I know that's lame.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, alright, let's assume your hypothesis. We went to dinner, we talked, we laughed, we kissed. Where did I have possibly gone wrong?

speaker: Howard
text: Think back, Leonard. The littlest things can set women off. Like, hey, the waitress is hot, I bet we could get her to come home with us. Or, how much does your mom weigh? I wanna know what I'm getting into.

speaker: Leonard
text: I didn't say anything like that.

speaker: Howard
text: Good, cause they don't work.

speaker: Raj
text: They also don't get hurt if you stare at them and hyperventilate. Sadly, that's my home run swing.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, everything went fine. I didn't even have to refer to my impromptu conversation starters. That woman across the hall is into me.

speaker: Howard
text: Let's go to the tape. Look at her reaction to the goodnight kiss. No change in respiration, pupils undilated, no flushing of the chest.

speaker: Raj
text: Nice close-up, by the way.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Interesting. Her jaws are clenched, no tongue access. Clearly a bad sign amongst mating humans.

speaker: Leonard
text: That's not a bad sign, please.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You might as well have been to a iguana with no dewlap enlargement.

speaker: Raj
text: And the worst sign of all is you're here and not there.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not there because I'm taking things slow. Which, by the way, compared to you guys, approaches warp speed. And take down that camera.

speaker: Raj
text: He was a lot more fun when he had no hope.
